why: The last layout in the matrix stops saying why it is kept although it meets the same `hud.css` queries as the laptop and TV layouts, so the matrix silently holds layouts the stylesheet cannot tell apart. The matrix test asks every such pair to declare itself. Anchored on the FINAL entry before the closing bracket, so adding a layout at the end moves this find string -- it did exactly that when 2560x1440 landed (issue #845).
killedBy: screen sweep layout matrix (issue #766) keeps no two layouts hud.css cannot tell apart, unless one says why in sameQueriesAs
